summary: The maintenance page ships in this image, and DjangoLux's Operations panel can restart, recreate and read the logs of services.
highlights: composer-agent publishes the maintenance page on the runtime volume (stack schema 3); check --fix migrates existing stacks, and the repair preview shows that change first.
Operations for DjangoLux 1.13's panel: list services, restart or recreate allow-listed ones with the deployment's secrets, and read the logs of one service or all of them.
release-manifest.json replaces VERSION; stack hardening (read-only socket proxy, pinned images, DAC_OVERRIDE).
Includes the 1.6.1 betas: dlux update/rollback back up first, outbox backoff, stack-schema finding.
